summary: Los Angeles resident, software engineer with a focus on UI/UX and application development, yoga instructor, strong advocate for ethical business practices and corporate accountability, critical of corporate lobbying and wealth inequality, interested in technology trends and their societal impacts, concerned about health issues related to sedentary work, experienced in remote work environments, critical of the current state of the tech industry and its treatment of employees, engaged in discussions about political and economic systems, particularly in relation to healthcare and education.
